course.title: Engineering Economy
course.department: Department of Industrial Engineering and Management

content.value: Samsung Electronics is trying to reduce supply chain risk by making more responsibly make-buy decision through improved cost estimation. A high-use component (expected usage is 5000 units per year) can be purchased for Tk 25 per unit with delivery promised within a week. Alternatively, Samsung can make the component in-house and have it readily available at a cost of Tk 5 per unit, if equipment costing Tk 150,000 is purchased. Labor and other operating costs are estimated to be Tk35,000 per year over the study period of 5 years. Salvage is estimated at 10% of first cost and i=12% per year. Neglect the element of availability (i) to determine the breakeven quantity and (ii) to recommend making or buying at the expected usage level.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2019
